title: Scientists just found a loophole that could let black holes split in two
caption:
Physics suggests a single black hole could divide into two. It all comes down to how fast they rotate.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists just found a loophole that could let black holes split in two

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261101010525.htm
